name: better-sqlite3
description: Local shim: implements the subset of the better-sqlite3 client API that drizzle-orm/better-sqlite3 calls, backed by Node's built-in node:sqlite instead of a native addon. See apps/api/src/db/client.ts and M2_P1 spec 'Known execution risks' (better-sqlite3 has no prebuilt binary for this Node/OS/arch and there is no local MSVC toolchain to compile it from source).
